requirement.fact: {efficiency_emilia} mentioned that the KPI definition process is currently manual.
requirement.reading: She would accept an automated KPI definition if it clearly supports the agreed business goals.

speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: You are treating my manual KPI definition as a bug, but it is the only place I ensure metrics align with margin and waste goals. Automating that step without my sign off removes business logic, and I will not support it.
output.correction: I did not say the process is too slow or that I want it replaced by a tool. I said it is manual because I need to verify that every feature maps to a strategic objective before we commit to it.
